about: Supreme Infrastructure India Ltd is a Mumbai EPC contractor for roads/highways, bridges, buildings, rail, power and water/sewerage infrastructure. After years of default and operating contraction, it is implementing a court-approved lender compromise, restarting EPC execution and pursuing legacy claims. [1]
